method: Chapter boundaries come from level-1 PDF bookmarks matching the current TeX short chapter title; printed page numbers use PDF PageLabels, with no fixed offsets.

Each PDF inclusion is recorded separately from its actual q/cm/Q/Do transformation, including the Form Matrix and nested clipping-wrapper forms. Repeated and cropped assets retain every occurrence and their scale/page ranges.

Printed point sizes are source PDF span sizes multiplied by the accumulated form scale. Tick minima use numeric/K-path text immediately outside the plot rectangle; a modal fallback is labelled explicitly.

Regular-label minima use nonnumeric spans of at least three characters, normally legends/axis labels/titles. Isolated chemical subscripts are excluded; examples and complete source-size counts are retained for review.
The threshold is a quantitative type-size check, not a substitute for rendered-page inspection. Text converted to vector outlines or embedded in raster images is explicitly sent for manual review.
All figure environments, including ContinuedFloat environments without independent labels, are included in the TeX inventory.

change_scope.readability_changes: Font and panel-layout changes preserve the existing plotted datasets, polarizations, colors and line styles; numerical extraction/source checks are documented in the associated reproduction and source files.
scientific_corrections_separate_from_rea: Three absorption figures (proj1.12a, S1.14a, S1.20) correct the verified E/h vs E/hbar factor of 2*pi and explicitly report nm^-1.

The monolayer reflectivity inclusion switches from old S1.14d.pdf to the existing S1.14d_correct.pdf, whose twelve curves match the same NPZ sources and standard formula; the old PDF remains untouched.

Scalar-derived off-diagonal optical panels are removed because the scalar formulas do not define independent off-diagonal observables; complete original dielectric-tensor components remain displayed with their scientific limitation stated.
change_scope.numerical_optics_evidence: figures_proj1/optics_sources.json records 291 old-reference and 291 revised-figure curve checks against source data, plus the separate failed old reflectivity-reference checks.
